fullContentHtml:
Bihar BPSC AES Result 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Result for the post of Assistant Environmental Scientist (AES). This recruitment was released for 17 posts. Online applying process for Bihar BPSC AES Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 19 September 2026. The Mains Examination was conducted on 11 June 2026 Candidates must check the complete details for Bihar BPSC AES Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 August 2025
  • Last Date : 19 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 11 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 04 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key / OMR Sheet : 27 July to 02 August 2026
  • Result : 30 October 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar BPSC AES Result 2026?

Bihar BPSC AES Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
